DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお困りですか。お連れの方は歩けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is something wrong? Can the person with you walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が急に気分が悪いと言って、ベンチに座っています。普段と違うので、職員の方に来てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者の急な不調と職員来訪を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend suddenly said they felt unwell and is sitting on a bench. This is unusual for them, so I'd like a staff member to come.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a staff member to come because your companion suddenly feels unwell. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所はどちらのベンチですか。今、返事はできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which bench are you at? Can your friend respond right now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池の手前です。話しかけると返事はしますが、歩くのはつらいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正確な場所と応答あり歩行困難を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's before the pond. They respond when I speak to them, but say walking is difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the exact location and explain that your friend responds but has difficulty walking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その場所へ職員を呼びます。お一人にせず、そばにいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll call a staff member to that location. Please stay with your friend and don't leave them alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。水を飲ませたり、入口まで歩かせたりする前に、来てもらうのを待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人にせず飲水や移動を強いず援助を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll wait for someone to come before giving them water or having them walk to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will stay with your friend, avoid forcing them to drink or move, and wait for help. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 職員に状態を伝えます。いつから、どのような変化がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the staff about their condition. When did it start, and what changes have you noticed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 数分前です。顔色が普段より悪い気がします。原因は分かりません。本人の言ったことをそのまま伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開始時刻と観察と原因不明を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: A few minutes ago. I think their complexion looks worse than usual. I don't know the cause. I'll pass on exactly what they said.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain when it started, what you observed, and that the cause is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。状況に応じて緊急の連絡をしますので、変化があればすぐ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll make an emergency call if the situation calls for it, so please tell us immediately if anything changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人のそばへ戻ります。場所と症状を職員に説明し、返事が変わったらすぐ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 付き添いに戻り変化を即報告すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go back to my friend. I'll explain the location and symptoms to the staff and let them know immediately if my friend's responses change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will return to your companion and immediately report any change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 職員がそちらへ向かいます。ベンチの場所で合流して、様子を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: A staff member is on the way to you. Please meet them at the bench and tell them how your friend is doing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機に休止の表示が出ましたね。お金は入れられましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The ticket machine is showing an out-of-service message. Did you put any money in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入れましたが、切符もおつりも出ていません。画面が変わって操作できなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休止後の未発券未返金と投入済みを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but neither a ticket nor any change has come out. The screen changed, and I can't operate it anymore.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you inserted money but received neither a ticket nor a refund after the machine stopped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのままお待ちください。何を入れたか、覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please wait here. Do you remember what you put in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 千円札一枚と硬貨です。硬貨は友人が入れたので、私だけでは合計を言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の紙幣と友人硬貨で総額不明を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: One 1,000-yen note and some coins. My friend put in the coins, so I can't tell you the total on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you inserted a note and your friend inserted coins, so you do not yet know the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご友人にも確認してください。取引の状態を職員が調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check with your friend too. A staff member will look into the transaction's status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は百円玉を二枚入れたそうです。合わせて千二百円です。自分で数えた部分と友人の説明を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人確認で総額を根拠別に訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend says they put in two 100-yen coins. That makes 1,200 yen altogether. I'll distinguish what I counted myself from what my friend told me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the total after checking with your friend, distinguishing the sources of your information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その金額と未発券の状態を確認します。もう一度別の機械で購入されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check that amount and confirm that no ticket was issued. Have you already bought another ticket from a different machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。ここで返金されるか切符が出るか分からないので、同じ区間を二回買わずに待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二重購入せず元取引確認を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I don't know whether this machine will return the money or issue a ticket, so I'm waiting instead of paying twice for the same journey.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you are waiting for the original transaction to be checked without buying a duplicate ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認します。急いでいる列車の時刻はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check. Is there a train departure you're trying to catch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次の列車です。間に合わない時は、元の取引の扱いと、その後の購入方法を窓口で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 希望便と間に合わない場合の取引確認後購入を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: The next train. If I can't make it, I'll ask at the counter how the original transaction will be handled and how to buy my ticket afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain which train you want and ask about checking the transaction and then buying a ticket if you miss it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この機械を職員が確認します。投入された二人とも、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: A staff member will check this machine. Both of you who inserted money, please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知の説明をご希望ですね。どこが分かりにくいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like an explanation of the notice. Which part is unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 漢字は読めますが、「提出」の所が分かりません。ここへ持ってくるのか、郵送するのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音読可だが提出方法が不明と具体化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can read the kanji, but I don't understand the part about submission. I'd like to know whether to bring it here or send it by post.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Specify that you can read the text aloud but do not understand how to submit it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出方法の案内は次のページにあります。一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The submission instructions are on the next page. Let's check them together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 次のページも持ってきました。封筒が入っていたので、郵送だけだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二ページ目を示し同封封筒による思込みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought the next page too. Since there was an envelope enclosed, I thought posting it was the only option.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the second page and explain your assumption based on the enclosed envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内では持参についても説明しています。どちらをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: These instructions also explain bringing it in person. Which would you prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 勤務中に窓口へ来にくいので、郵送したいです。添付書類は原本ですか、それとも写しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務都合の郵送希望と原本写しを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's difficult to come to the counter during work, so I'd like to post it. Should the supporting documents be originals or copies?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you prefer posting because of work and ask whether originals or copies are needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類ごとに指定が違います。この一覧を担当者と確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The requirements differ by document. Let's go over this list with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 全部原本を送る前に、一覧の「写し」の物を分けたいです。コピーした後、元の書類は残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定別に分け原本保持を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before sending all the originals, I'd like to separate out the items marked “copy” on the list. I'll keep the original documents after copying them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to sort the documents by their requirements and keep the originals. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。記入漏れの確認もしてから発送してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please also check that nothing has been left blank before posting them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 添付書類を担当の方と確認してから郵送します。原本を送る物と、コピーでよい物が分かるよう、一覧に印を付けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当と添付確認後に郵送し原本写しを一覧で区別したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll post them after checking the supporting documents with the person in charge. I'd like to mark the list to distinguish documents that must be originals from those that can be copies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to check the attachments with the person in charge before posting and to distinguish originals from copies on the list. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この一覧に確認欄があります。郵送のご希望と、原本・写しの確認が必要な点を担当へ伝えました。通知一式をお持ちになってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: This list has a check column. I've told the person in charge that you prefer posting and need to confirm the original and copy requirements. Please take the complete notice with you and proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診ですね。ご本人確認の書類をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit. Please show me your identification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。待合室でフルネームを大きく呼ばれるのが気になります。別の呼び出し方を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 氏名確認書類を示し大声フルネーム以外の呼出を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here it is. I'm uncomfortable with having my full name called loudly in the waiting room. Could we discuss another way of calling me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show your identification and ask about a calling method other than loudly announcing your full name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付の登録には、ご本人の氏名が必要です。呼出方法については確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need your own name to register you at reception. I'll check about the calling method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 登録名を変えてほしいわけではありません。本人確認はこの名前でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正式登録名変更ではないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm not asking you to change my registered name. Please use this name to verify my identity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that you are not asking to change your official registered name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。番号での呼出しなど、今日対応できる方法を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. I'll ask the person in charge what we can do today, such as calling you by number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。番号になったら、私が聞き逃さないよう表示も見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号なら表示も自分で見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. If you use a number, I'll also watch the display so I don't miss it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will also watch the display if numbers are used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できました。この受付では番号でご案内します。診察室では別途ご本人の確認をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've confirmed it. At this reception desk, we'll call you by number. Your identity will be checked separately in the consultation room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 診察室で名前を聞かれたら答えます。待合室の番号と、診察の本人確認は別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号呼出と室内本人確認を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll answer if I'm asked my name in the consultation room. Being called by number in the waiting room is separate from identity verification during the consultation, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish being called by number from identity verification in the consultation room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。この紙に受付番号があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Your reception number is on this slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号を確かめました。待合室ではこの番号を見て待ち、診察室では自分の氏名を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付番号保持と室内氏名回答を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the number. I'll watch for it while waiting in the waiting room and give my name in the consultation room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will keep the reception number and give your name in the consultation room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その紙をお持ちになってお待ちください。呼出方法のご希望も担当へ共有しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep that slip with you and wait. I've also told the person in charge about your preferred calling method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾った鍵をお持ちですね。どこで見つけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've brought in some keys you found. Where did you find them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩道です。SNSで写真を出せば持ち主が見つかるかと思いましたが、投稿する前に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未投稿の拾得鍵を届けSNS探索の考えを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: On the pavement. I thought posting a photo on social media might help find the owner, but I came here before posting anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Hand in found keys that you have not posted about and explain your idea of looking for the owner on social media. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現物はこちらで確認します。まだ写真は公開していないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll examine the actual keys here. You haven't made any photos public yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。鍵の形や付いている物が見える写真は、自分の電話にあるだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真が個人端末内のみと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct. The photos showing the shape of the keys and what's attached to them are only on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the photos are only on your personal device. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拾った場所と時刻を伺います。建物の入口付近でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask where and when you found them. Were they near a building entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口から少し離れた歩道です。近くの建物の鍵かどうかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 建物との関係を断定せず歩道位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: On the pavement a little away from the entrance. I don't know whether they are keys to a nearby building.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the location on the pavement without assuming a connection to a building. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのように記録します。ご自身で近くの鍵穴に試したりはされていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record that. You haven't tried them in nearby keyholes yourself, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: していません。何の鍵か推測して試すより、このままお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵穴試行なしと現物引渡しを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. Rather than guessing what they unlock and trying them, I'll hand them over as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you have not tried any locks and choose to hand over the actual keys. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。届出の内容と、拾得された方のご希望を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll confirm the details of the report and your wishes as the finder.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真は公開せず、歩道で拾った時刻と場所だけを説明します。目印が付いたまま現物を届けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 特徴非公開で事実と現物を届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't make the photos public. I'll just explain when and where I found the keys on the pavement. I'll hand them in with the identifying attachment still on them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep identifying details private and hand in the actual keys with the facts of the find. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではお預かりします。こちらで鍵の特徴を確認して、届出を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll take them now. We'll check their distinguishing features here and proceed with the report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居される方のお名前を確認します。お一人でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me confirm the names of the people moving. Is it just you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人です。同居人も後で同じ新居へ来るので、今まとめて転送したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別時期同居人を含む転送希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two people. My housemate will come to the same new home later, so I'd like to arrange forwarding for both of us now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want mail forwarding including a housemate moving at a different time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人とも、同じ日から新しい住所で受け取るご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Would both of you like to receive mail at the new address from the same date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は来週ですが、同居人は一か月後です。まだ旧居で受け取る予定を聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人の時期差と同居人受取希望未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm moving next week, but my housemate is moving in a month. I haven't asked whether they still plan to receive mail at the old home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the different moving dates and that you have not confirmed your housemate's mail preferences. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでしたら、同居人の方の希望も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, please check what your housemate wants too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私だけの希望で二人分を出すのはやめます。今日は私の分だけとして相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人分を独断申請せず本人分だけ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't apply for both of us based only on my own preference. Could I discuss just my own forwarding today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid applying for someone else without consulting them and ask about your own mail only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の分について確認します。ほかの方の転居届は、その方の状況に合わせてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check your own forwarding. Please discuss any other person's moving notice according to their circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同居人へは、旧居で受け取る間と転送を始めたい日を確認するよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同居人が確認すべき旧居受取と開始日を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my housemate to confirm how long they'll receive mail at the old home and the date they'd like forwarding to start.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your housemate should confirm the period for receiving mail at the old home and the forwarding start date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今回はお客様のお名前と新旧の住所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. For now, let's confirm your name and your old and new addresses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この名前が私です。同居人の欄は今回に含めず、私の希望日で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回の本人氏名住所希望日の範囲を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: This is my name. Please leave my housemate's section out this time and check the date I want for myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that this application covers only your own name, addresses, and desired date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容でご案内します。二人分が一緒に始まるという扱いにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll proceed on that basis. We won't treat this as forwarding for both people starting together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お名前の変更についてでしょうか。現在の登録名をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about changing your name? Please give your currently registered name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 結婚して姓が変わりました。古い名前の通帳に、新しい名前を自分で書いてしまっていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 改姓後通帳を自分で書換えてよいか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My surname changed when I got married. Can I write my new name myself in the bankbook bearing my old name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may alter your bankbook yourself after changing your surname. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通帳をご自身で書き換えず、登録変更の手続きを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't alter the bankbook yourself. Check the procedure for changing your registered information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。新しい氏名の身分証と、以前の名前が分かる資料があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自筆変更を避け新旧氏名資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I have identification in my new name and documents showing my previous name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid changing it by hand and show documents for both your old and new names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新旧のお名前を確認できる資料を拝見します。ほかの登録情報も変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me see the documents that confirm your old and new names. Has any other registered information changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所も変わりました。名前だけを直せば全部終わると思わず、住所も一緒に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所変更も別に必要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My address has changed too. I don't want to assume changing just the name completes everything; I'd like to discuss the address as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that an address change is also needed separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 両方の変更を確認しましょう。給与を受け取る口座としてお使いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check both changes. Do you use this account to receive your salary?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。銀行の登録が変わったら、会社にも受取名義を確認します。まだ変更済みとは会社に言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 給与名義を会社へ伝える時点は完了後にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Once the bank's records have changed, I'll also confirm the account holder name with my employer. I won't tell them the change is complete yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will inform your employer about the salary account name after the change is completed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 手続きが完了した範囲を確認してから、ご勤務先へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please confirm which procedures have been completed before informing your employer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料を出して、氏名と住所を変更したいです。確認が終わるまで古い通帳も捨てずに持っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧資料保持で氏名住所の変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to submit the documents and change my name and address. I'll keep the old bankbook without discarding it until the checks are finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request changes to your name and address while keeping the old documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では新旧の氏名と住所を順に確認します。通帳もそのままお預かりして拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check your old and new names and addresses in order. We'll also take a look at your bankbook as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 備蓄用の食品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for emergency food supplies?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。長く保存できる物を選びたいです。ただ、調理にたくさん水を使う物は避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長期保存と調理水制約を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to choose food that keeps for a long time. But I want to avoid anything that uses a lot of water to prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your need for long storage and limited preparation water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保存期限と調理方法を、別々に確認しましょう。気になった商品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the storage life and preparation method separately. Is there a product you're interested in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この乾燥ご飯です。表示を見ると、水を入れて待つ必要がありました。飲む水の量も考えないといけませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乾燥米の給水必要を読み飲料水との兼合いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This dried rice. The label says I need to add water and wait. I have to consider the amount of drinking water too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read that dried rice requires water and explain the balance with drinking water supplies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 水が必要な物と、開けて食べられる物を組み合わせる方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also combine foods that need water with foods you can eat straight after opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は調理用の水を使わない物を選びます。この缶は道具なしで開けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無給水食へ優先変更し缶の開け方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today I'll choose things that don't use water for preparation. Can I open this can without tools?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize food needing no added water and ask how to open the can. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ふたの表示をご覧ください。こちらは開けるためのつまみがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please look at the label on the lid. This one has a tab for opening it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この形なら開けられそうです。家族に硬い物が苦手な人がいるので、中身の硬さも見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開封可を確認し家族の硬さ条件を追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It looks like I can open this type. Someone in my family has trouble with hard foods, so I'd like to check the texture of the contents too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you can open it and add your family's requirement about food hardness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品の説明と原材料をご確認ください。食べやすさは、普段の食事も参考に選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the product description and ingredients. Consider your family's usual meals when choosing food that's easy for them to eat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず少量を買って家族と試します。食べ方と開け方が合うと分かった商品を、次に備蓄用として買い足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 試食用少量で適合確認後に備蓄を増やす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll buy a small amount first and try it with my family. Once we know the food and opening method suit us, I'll buy more of that product for our emergency supplies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Try a small amount and increase your supplies after confirming suitability. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それなら必要な条件を確認できますね。購入後も保存の表示と期限を見て管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: That will let you check the conditions you need. After buying, keep track of the storage instructions and expiry dates too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 撮影される場合も、こちらの通路は空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please keep this passage clear even when taking photographs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三脚が通路にはみ出していました。すぐ移します。あの広い所なら置いてもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通路の三脚を移し候補位置の可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My tripod was sticking out into the passage. I'll move it right away. May I set it up in that wide space?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Move the tripod out of the passage and ask whether the proposed location is allowed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通行の妨げにならないか、現地の表示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please also check the signs there to see whether it would obstruct people passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表示を見ます。人が写らないよう、ほかの方が通り終わるのを待っていたんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示を確認し写り込まないため待っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll check the signs. I was waiting for everyone else to pass so they wouldn't appear in my photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will check the signs and explain that you were waiting to keep others out of the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通行する方を止めたり、移動を求めたりはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please don't stop people passing or ask them to move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。人を退かせるのではなく、三脚をたたんで手持ちにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人に退去を求めず手持ちへ変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Instead of asking people to move away, I'll fold up the tripod and take photos holding the camera.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Switch to handheld photography without asking others to leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのほうが場所を変えやすいですね。周りをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That will make it easier to change locations. Please check your surroundings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路の脇から、写り込まない方向を選びます。今は人が多いので、撮らずに少し待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行脇の構図を選び混雑時撮影を控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll choose a direction from the side of the passage where people won't be in the picture. It's crowded now, so I'll wait a little without taking photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a composition from beside the passage and refrain from photographing while it is crowded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 待つ時も通路を空けてください。荷物もまとまっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the passage clear while waiting too. Are your belongings gathered together as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 荷物も足元にまとめました。人の通行を優先して、空いた時に手持ちで撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物をまとめ通行優先の手持ち撮影にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've gathered them at my feet too. I'll give people passing priority and take handheld photos when there's space.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Gather your belongings and take handheld photographs with priority given to people passing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。撮影後も、荷物の置き忘れにお気を付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do that. Take care not to leave any belongings behind after taking photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの通路を進んで、奥で左に曲がってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Go along this passage, then turn left at the far end.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、周りの音で聞き取りにくいです。地図を指しながら、一つずつ説明していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 騒音で聞き取りにくく地図で一段ずつ説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry, the noise around us makes it hard to hear. Could you explain one step at a time while pointing to the map?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that noise makes it hard to hear and request directions one step at a time on a map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: もちろんです。まず、今いる場所がこの印です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Of course. First, this mark is where you are now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。次に行く場所だけ教えてください。二つ先まで言われると覚えにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在地を理解し次地点だけ説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. Please tell me only the next place to go. It's hard to remember when you describe two steps ahead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you understand your current location and ask for only the next point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、このエレベーターへ向かってください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここですね。乗る階を紙に書いてもらえますか。数字なら見て確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次地点を確認して階の数字を筆記依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here, right? Could you write the floor I should go to on paper? I can check it visually if it's a number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the next point and ask for the floor number in writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この階です。降りた後は、行先表示のある案内板をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is the floor. After getting out, look at the information board showing destinations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙の階へ行って、案内板で自分の行先を確かめます。分からなければ、その階の職員にこの紙を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 筆記階と掲示確認と困った時の紙提示を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll go to the floor on the paper and check my destination on the board. If I don't understand, I'll show this paper to a staff member on that floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the written floor, the signboard check, and showing the paper if you need help. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。こちらに目的の行先も書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. I'll write your destination here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 階と行先が分かりました。まずエレベーターへ行き、先の道は案内板か職員に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 階と行先の紙を保持し一手順ずつ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Now I know the floor and destination. I'll go to the lift first, then check the route beyond it on the board or with a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the paper with the floor and destination and proceed one step at a time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この紙をお持ちください。エレベーターの入口は、見えているあちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take this paper. The lift entrance is over there, where you can see it.
